source_note: Basic boundary dimensions are ISO 15 for the 62xx and 63xx deep-groove series; these are fixed by standard and identical across manufacturers. Abutment dimensions (da_min, Da_max) are manufacturer recommendations and are only recorded where directly sourced. Entries without them say so rather than carrying a guess.

sources.what: ISO 15 boundary dimensions, 62xx/63xx deep groove ball bearings

stationary_outer.when: the load direction is fixed relative to the outer ring, and the ring may be axially displaced in the housing
stationary_outer.note: The general-purpose case: a shaft supported by two bearings where one must float to take up thermal growth.

unsourced.note: J7, K7, M7, N7 and P7 housing classes and the shaft classes (js5/j6/k5/k6/m5/m6/n6) are deliberately absent. Their fundamental deviations were not obtained from a source that could be corroborated, and a fit table that is wrong produces a part that assembles wrongly with nothing to indicate it. Add them from ISO 286-2 directly.
